note: Both sets correctly capture the PVC material requirement for supply and waste pipe and the 1/4 in/ft minimum waste pipe slope per 2009 IRC. Set A additionally extracts three well-supported facts from the section drawings: the INT. STEP and FINISH FLOOR elevations (2'-6 1/8" and 2'-0 3/8") relative to the 0" ground plane, and the 1/2" = 1'-0" scale of the Water Supply Longitudinal Section. Set B omits these entirely, so it misses important dimensional information without gaining any accuracy advantage.
